transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Salieri! I’ve been away for two weeks on the Emperor’s business, trusting you to keep the rehearsals on schedule! The singers don’t know their entrances, the second violin parts are missing entirely, and someone has rewritten my stage directions without a word to me! The premiere is in ten days! You gave me your word that everything would be in order!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer

Ah, my dear colleague, it is indeed unfortunate that you return to such disarray. I must admit that some unforeseen challenges have arisen in your absence. However, I assure you that I have done my utmost to maintain order in your stead.

Regarding the singers' lack of preparedness, I have attempted to work with them in your absence, but it seems they require your direct guidance to fully grasp their entrances. As for the missing second violin parts, I must apologize for the oversight on my part. I shall rectify this immediately by copying them myself.

As for the unauthorized rewriting of your stage directions, I can only imagine the frustration you must feel. I was not aware of any changes being made without your consultation, and I understand the importance of maintaining artistic integrity. Please rest assured that I shall address this matter promptly and ensure that your original vision is upheld.

With ten days remaining until the premiere, we must work together diligently to bring everything back on track. Your expertise and leadership are indispensable in this situation, and I am committed to supporting you in any way I can to ensure the success of our opera. Let us collaborate closely in the days ahead to restore order and excellence to our production.

We have ten days, Salieri. We must mend what's been undone, quickly. I will not let this turn into a fiasco, and neither should you. Let's commit to setting this right, starting immediately.
